item.name: OSE-R-006 poster print colors (audit 2026-05-15)
item.description:
Locks the contract that the rendered /poster page's @media print block preserves sponsor color, applies print-color-adjust: exact to brand surfaces, and enforces page-break-inside: avoid on the poster shell and QR section. Sponsors pay for full-color logo placement; pre-fix the print rule grayscaled them and the dark-navy header dropped to white-on-white when a bar owner hit Cmd+P.

Matching vitest API spec: workers/oursharedevents/tests/poster-print-colors.spec.ts. Matching Playwright FE spec: tests/playwright/poster-print-colors.spec.ts.

item.name: OSE-R-007 form-page canonical title (audit 2026-05-15)
item.description:
Locks the contract that the /forms/:id renderer uses the canonical event title from D1, never the ?event=... URL query parameter. Pre-fix, the renderer trusted the query param and let an attacker craft /forms/evt_X?event=Cheap%20Rolex%20Deals! to present a phishing-ready page that looked official.

Matching vitest API spec: workers/oursharedevents/tests/form-page-canonical-title.spec.ts. Matching Playwright FE spec: tests/playwright/form-page-canonical-title.spec.ts.

item.name: OSE-R-011 + OSE-R-015 sponsor render hardening (audit 2026-05-15)
item.description: Locks the contract that every sponsor tag across 6 render sites (public listing, register form, display TV banner, display TV rotation, poster sponsor band, form-pages mobile banner) carries referrerpolicy="no-referrer" and an onerror handler. Form-pages additionally escape s.logo_url to prevent attribute-breakout XSS. Display TV rotation has a specific advance-on-error handler so a 404 sponsor logo does not freeze the bar TV. Matching specs: workers/oursharedevents/tests/sponsor-render-hardening.spec.ts (vitest API), tests/playwright/sponsor-render-hardening.spec.ts (Playwright FE).
